script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Summer of Blossoms

FADE IN:

INT. FARMHOUSE - KITCHEN - MORNING

ELLEN (mid-30s, a warm and caring woman) stands at the kitchen counter, sipping a cup of coffee. She gazes out the window to the front yard. A garden hose snakes along the ground, leading to the flower bed that lines the driveway.

ELLEN
(talking to herself)
This is the year, I can feel it.

The front door creaks open and in walks her younger brother, JOSH (early 30s), carrying a large box marked 'Tools'.

JOSH
Morning, Sis.

Ellen smiles and greets her brother with a warm embrace.

ELLEN
(whispering)
Glad you're back.

JOSH
I missed you and the farm.

Ellen hands her brother a cup of coffee.

ELLEN
We've got a lot to catch up on. You won't believe what's happened this summer.

INT. FARMHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - LATER

Ellen and Josh sit on the worn couch, surrounded by photos of their family and their late parents.

ELLEN
Dad's rose garden never bloomed this year, and the town council threatened to tear it down. But something miraculous happened.

She shares with her brother how the townspeople rallied together to help restore the garden. The local flower shop donated seeds, the carpenter repaired the fence, and even the children gathered to help weed and plant.

JOSH
That's amazing.

ELLEN
It's more than that, Josh. It's a reminder that no matter how hard life gets, we can always come together to make things better.

INT. FARMHOUSE - KITCHEN - AFTERNOON

Ellen and Josh prepare lunch in the kitchen while chatting with one another. They discuss their plans for the summer and the impact the rose garden has had on the town.

ELLEN
You should see it now, Josh. The whole town is buzzing with energy, and it feels like we've all found a renewed sense of purpose.

JOSH
You're right. Maybe it's time I got involved again.

INT. FARMHOUSE - GARDEN - LATE AFTERNOON

Ellen and Josh work side by side in the garden, pulling weeds and planting new roses. They laugh and share stories, catching up on each other's lives.

ELLEN
You know, I'm glad you're here, Josh. It feels like things are finally coming together.

JOSH
I couldn't agree more. It's good to be back, Ellen.

INT. FARMHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Ellen and Josh gather around the dining room table with the townspeople to celebrate the successful revival of the rose garden. They share stories, eat homemade pie, and reminisce about the past.

ELLEN
(raising a glass)
To new beginnings, and to the power of community.

They all clink their glasses together and smile at one another.

EXT. FARMHOUSE - GARDEN - NIGHT

Ellen and Josh stand in the garden, gazing at the blooming roses under the starlit sky.

ELLEN
It's beautiful, isn't it?

JOSH
Yes, it is. And so are you, sis.

They share a heartfelt embrace.

FADE OUT.

THE END
